snippet.title: Grave Mistakes | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4635290/Grave_Mistakes/

Manage and supervise the Good Mourning™ Funeral Home in 2 - 4 player co-op. Grieving families need your attention: prepare bodies for their final viewing, give a passionate eulogy, and steal a couple of limbs on the way. Dinner has to come from somewhere.

Key Features

● Online co-op and proximity chat
● Run and manage a 'respectable' funeral home
● Chop and clean physics-based bodies
● Deceive families and avoid raising suspicion
● Give a eulogy and play the organ at ceremonies
● Replace limbs with various items
● Upgrade and improve your funeral home
● Figure out the mystery behind it all

Trailer by Oliver Cross, recut by Oro Interactive, Mark Benninghofen (narrator), Sean Antony (misc voices), and Joe Richardson (sound design). Additional voices by the Happy Volcano team.

Follow Happy Volcano:
Website: https://www.happyvolcano.com/
X: https://x.com/hvgames
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/@happyvolcanogames
